thread:
Sana Patel: @channel seeing a sudden spike of 503s for Brightfolio on hosted inference, started ~2026-03-18T17:08Z. Customer reports streaming aborts and timeouts. Example req id: brf-9c8a7f. Impact ~3% of their calls.

Sana Patel: snippet from runtime log we grabbed:
```
2026-03-18T17:08:12Z runtime[pid=12345] ERROR cuda: out of memory while allocating 2147483648 bytes
2026-03-18T17:08:12Z runtime[pid=12345] FATAL signal 11 (SIGSEGV) at 0x7f8e3b2c
```

Alex Gomez: which model/revision + pool? any autoscaler events? @OpsBot any related alerts?

OpsBot: Alert: hosted-infer-upstream-crash (severity=high) — 12 occurrences in 6m. pool=gpu-pool-rt-2. URL: http://ops/alerts/2345 :rotating_light:

Mike Liu: grabbing node logs now. Early look: GPU memory climbs to ~23.2GB then segfault. Could be OOM during kv-prefetch + dynbatch resize. Commands I ran:
```
kubectl -n hosted logs pod/infer-rt-2-abc -c runtime --tail=300
nvmlDeviceGetMemoryInfo(device=0) -> free=0.8GB total=24GB
gcore 12345 -o /tmp/core.infer.12345
```

Sana Patel: model=redwood-medium-v2, pinned_rev=r202603, kv_prefetch=true, dynbatch=on. Brightfolio traffic shows many long-embed calls (~100k tokens) starting at 17:06.

Alex Gomez: immediate mitigations: 1) route Brightfolio to fallback (cpu-quantized) model, 2) reduce max_batch_tokens on gpu-pool-rt-2, 3) drain affected pods. Can CS throttle at gateway?

CS Support: We're on call with Brightfolio now — they see 503s since ~17:08 and want ETA. Can we give temporary rollback window?

Mike Liu: doing a controlled rollback to pinned_rev=r202601 on that pool and lowering concurrent_batch_count to 2. Also collecting dmesg and kernel logs for OOM trace. Repro notes for eng: send burst of large-embed requests (context ~120k tokens) with kv_prefetch enabled.

Sana Patel: reproduction checklist: request shape, model rev, pool config, nvml output, core dump. I'll open bug linking these.

Alex Gomez: routing change applied for Brightfolio -> hosted-fallback-quant. Initial telemetry: 503s dropped from 3% -> 0.5%. :thumbsup:

Mike Liu: uploaded artifacts: /artifacts/8202022022/core-infer-12345.tar.gz and /artifacts/8202022022/nvml-logs.gz. Next: reproduce locally with same model rev + dynbatch.

Sana Patel: action items assigned: Alex (route + gateway throttle), Mike (collect & reproduce + upload dumps), Sana (bug + postmortem). Will update here once we have root cause.

CS Support: sharing update with Brightfolio: temporary routing and rollback in progress, next update in 30m.

Mike Liu: quick note — heap profile shows large KV prefetch windows when embed_size spikes; hypothesis: a regression in kv_prefetch memory accounting with dynbatch. Creating repro harness now.

Sana Patel: thanks team. Keeping thread open for postmortem. If anyone captures additional SIGSEGV stack traces, paste them here.
